content.thinking:
The 18:04 deploy changed the cache port from 6379 to 6380, causing connection refused errors to redis. Since the cache itself (owned by checkout-platform) is likely healthy and just being pointed at the wrong port by io-shop's config, this fits config-induced-failure exactly.

Latency confirms it: p50/p95 jumped from ~26ms to ~180-190ms right after 18:04, cache_hit_ratio fell to 0, and error rate ticked up slightly - all consistent with failed connection attempts adding overhead while the page still renders correctly since cache is optional.

hypotheses.subject: cache.port (deploy/values-production.yaml)
hypotheses.summary: The 18:04 deployment changed deploy/values-production.yaml, flipping the summary-cache port from 6379 to 6380. From that minute on, io-shop's connections to cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local:6380 were refused (the redis process was never listening there), driving cache_hit_ratio to 0 and pushing p50 latency from ~26ms to ~180-190ms as every account-page render exhausted its cache-lookup timeout before falling back. Source code is unchanged; only the config value is wrong.

supporting_evidence.claim: summary cache lookup failed - connection refused to redis://cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local:6380 (200 of 200 requests)
p50_ms jumped from 25 to 180 and cache_hit_ratio dropped from 0.9 to 0.46 then 0.0

hypotheses.subject: io-summary-cache
hypotheses.summary: If the port change is set aside, the observed symptom is that io-shop's dependency io-summary-cache (owned internally by checkout-platform) stopped accepting connections, and the latency/error rate rose while the alerting service's own code path was otherwise normal (cache is optional by design).

supporting_evidence.claim: summary cache lookup failed - connection refused to redis://cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local:6380 (93 of 200 requests)
io-summary-cache: internal, owned by checkout-platform, at cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local
